paraphrase_question: In Lagged-Exogenous Triage, why is selected_for_tensor=True impossible at k = 0, and what does the known_future_drivers opt-in change about this chronological-causality guard?
paraphrase: Out of the box, no driver can have selected_for_tensor set to True at lag k = 0, meaning the same time step as the target. To allow that, the use-case code must deliberately list the driver in `known_future_drivers`. The restriction is a design choice rather than a gap in the library: it exists to keep cause and effect in time order.
planted_question: When is it actually safe to opt a driver into the zero-lag known-future path?
planted_new: In practice we cap known-future opt-ins at 3 drivers per target, and only for values fixed at least 14 days ahead. One retail client opted in daily footfall: backtest MASE fell from 0.92 to 0.61, then live error tripled, because footfall is published the next morning. We now require a 48-hour publication-lag audit before any driver is opted in.
